attributes.description: Identifies DNS lookups of command and control domains used by the Frosted Needle ransomware, as reported in campaign PTF-00967. The indicators are synthetic and use reserved address and domain ranges, so they match no real traffic.

attributes.name: Frosted Needle Ransomware: DNS lookup of command and control domain (PTF-00967)
attributes.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating Frosted Needle Ransomware: DNS lookup of command and control domain

This rule matches indicators that the Partner Threat Feed attributes to the Frosted Needle ransomware in campaign PTF-00967.

### Possible investigation steps

- Review the matching event and the host or user it came from.
- Look for other indicators from the same campaign on the same host.
- Check the process tree around the event for the initial execution or delivery.

### Response and remediation

- Isolate the host if the match is confirmed.
- Block the indicators at the network edge and on endpoints.
- Reset credentials used on the host.
